researchDepth: Bounded five-Driver habit/automaticity/expectancy review; longitudinal versus randomized contrasts, response-scale overlap and failed experimental induction emphasized. Not a systematic review per Driver.

entityReviews.constructReview: Learned context→behavior propensity with reduced deliberation, not behavioral frequency alone.
entityReviews.measurementReview: SRHI includes repetition, automaticity and identity items; SRBAI removes some contamination but remains self-report. Devaluation insensitivity can also reflect deficient goal-directed control.
entityReviews.timeReview: Learning across weeks/months differs from expression over seconds; successful-learner curve threshold not universal acquisition time.
entityReviews.unresolved: Repetition/habit candidate remains RN: within-person improvement, successful-learner selection and assay limitations do not identify universal causal habit gain.

entityReviews.constructReview: Multiple automaticity dimensions: speed, efficiency, intention and awareness may dissociate.
entityReviews.measurementReview: A four-item self-report subscale does not demonstrate all speed/interference/awareness facets. Habit composites containing the same items cannot independently cause their own subscale.
entityReviews.timeReview: Available execution features versus enduring acquired cue propensity; short task effects not lifelong automaticity.
entityReviews.unresolved: Layer feature-scope blocker applies; no whole multidimensional automaticity increase or scalar composite identity forced.

entityReviews.constructReview: Learned association between a specific cue and response representation; not just frequent responding or cue accessibility.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Cue→response priming distinguished from neutral→cue accessibility and goal performance. Shared reaction-time measures need baseline and exact lexical contrasts.
entityReviews.timeReview: Rapid plan encoding may affect a task immediately, unlike months-long habit development; frozen metadata retained not generalized.
entityReviews.unresolved: If-then-plan effect RN pending exact priming contrast and source identity reconciliation; no mediation record or automaticity-profile effect.

entityReviews.constructReview: Expected reinforcement probability AND subjective value after a response in context; not reward amount or reward sensitivity.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Probability, value and product cannot be substituted without explicit scale/operation; choice, anticipatory pleasure and expectancy ratings differ.
entityReviews.timeReview: Recent updating versus stable sensitivity; extinction/devaluation may change value without changing remembered probability.
entityReviews.unresolved: Multidimensional probability/value target not satisfied by one manipulated reward or choice score; no signed effect retained.

entityReviews.constructReview: Expectation of an action's outcome acquired by observing another person's behavior/consequence; acquisition route matters.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Cue-pain intensity expectancy and imitation performance are not necessarily action-outcome probability. Vicarious efficacy is not expected outcome likelihood.
entityReviews.timeReview: Observation followed by prediction/choice; no inference of learning failure from no imitation or of durable transfer from one exposure.
entityReviews.unresolved: Observational-pain evidence does not yet align exact action/probability endpoint; no causal edge or effect forced.

existingReviews.rationale: Habit-strength composites include automaticity items and the definition already specifies reduced deliberation. Contemporaneous composite/subscale correlation cannot establish independent cause.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Habit and automaticity remain distinct canonically, but shared items and lack of independent temporally ordered measures challenge the causal reading. Failed devaluation induction also cautions against treating every automatic response as acquired habit.
existingReviews.proposal: Future noncausal construct/measurement-overlap review under exact context, behavior and independent indicators; no exact replacement predicate or reclassification proposed.
existingReviews.rdsReview: All endpoints Drivers, no direct RDS target or formula edge. Composite/item overlap is not permission to reclassify; prevent same cue contribution being counted twice.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing propositions unchanged, V1 incomplete and not newly executable. Source-family ownership preserved; REL-PSY-036 ownerPSY-F09 reviewed once here.

existingReviews.rationale: Stronger cue-response links may facilitate particular initiation features, but whole PSY-071 automaticity is multidimensional and may share priming/latency indicators with the source.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Efficient, rapid, unintentional and unaware responding are not equivalent; incompatible goals and inhibition can override expression. SRC120 stored title/authors/year differ from its PMID.
existingReviews.proposal: Future claim must specify independently measured cue-link strength, particular automaticity dimension, temporal separation and cue/goal/inhibition scope. Do not generalize rapid priming to every automaticity feature.
existingReviews.rdsReview: All endpoints Drivers, no direct RDS target or formula edge. Composite/item overlap is not permission to reclassify; prevent same cue contribution being counted twice.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing propositions unchanged, V1 incomplete and not newly executable. Source-family ownership preserved; REL-PSY-036 ownerPSY-F09 reviewed once here.

existingReviews.rationale: An assigned if-then planning operation is not a measured increase in PSY-075 strength. Cue accessibility and cue-response association are different mediator candidates; performance does not identify both.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Weak/inactive goal conditions showed no goal-performance benefit; measured-goal interaction not randomized moderator. Source120 bibliography and priming details need reconciliation.
existingReviews.proposal: Future scope should separate randomized plan formation from measured implementation-intention strength, exact cue-response priming from cue salience, and immediate encoding from later durable habit. No transmitted pathway or universal effect.
existingReviews.rdsReview: All endpoints Drivers, no direct RDS target or formula edge. Composite/item overlap is not permission to reclassify; prevent same cue contribution being counted twice.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing propositions unchanged, V1 incomplete and not newly executable. Source-family ownership preserved; REL-PSY-036 ownerPSY-F09 reviewed once here.

hypotheses.question: Stable-cue behavioral repetition increases Habit Strength.
hypotheses.reason: Longitudinal change/repetition association does not isolate repetition from motivation, context and reporting; candidate EA0014 remains UNKNOWN.

hypotheses.question: Frequency is identical to habit.
hypotheses.reason: Repeated deliberate behavior can remain goal-directed; context-linked automatic propensity requires independent evidence.

hypotheses.question: Habit scale causes its automaticity subscale.
hypotheses.reason: Overlapping measurement items are not temporal causal mechanisms.

hypotheses.question: An automaticity self-report gain increases every PSY-071 dimension.
hypotheses.reason: Same Layer feature-scope problem: speed, efficiency, awareness and intention not all verified.

hypotheses.question: If-then planning strengthens a cue-response link.
hypotheses.reason: Exact priming contrast and current-cue scope needed; plan assignment and PSY-075 strength are distinct. EA0015 records unresolved effect.

hypotheses.question: Plan→cue accessibility→response association→behavior is a transmitted pathway.
hypotheses.reason: Parallel mediators reported in regression are not identified sequential causal segments.

hypotheses.question: A habit forms in exactly66days for everyone.
hypotheses.reason: Curve fits and conditional successful-learner summaries vary and can extrapolate beyond observed84days.

hypotheses.question: Pre/post intervention meta-analysis proves randomized causal benefit.
hypotheses.reason: Within-arm change is not a control-adjusted intervention contrast.

hypotheses.question: No routine/time-cue difference proves both outperform no planning.
hypotheses.reason: Both randomized conditions received planning; no untreated comparator.

hypotheses.question: Acute stress increases habitual control.
hypotheses.reason: Original positive effect conflicts with task-limited exact replication and other paradigm nulls; stress exposure not PSY-054 appraisal.

hypotheses.question: Failed devaluation proves absence of all real-world habits.
hypotheses.reason: Assay sensitivity and goal-directed learning failure can obscure or mimic habits.

hypotheses.question: Stress modifies REL-PSY-035 cue-link→automaticity.
hypotheses.reason: No independent exact edge interaction, aligned dimension and timing established.

hypotheses.question: Relocation reduces Habit Strength.
hypotheses.reason: Relocation not randomized; intervention effects on behavior not exact habit weakening. Opportunity change may block expression without erasing association.

hypotheses.question: Travel/membership delta scientifically proves habit deletion.
hypotheses.reason: Scenario configuration is not subjective propensity or empirical consequence evidence.

hypotheses.question: App reminders strengthen habit.
hypotheses.reason: Small micro-randomized trial suggests combined prompts+commitment; component effect and self-report latent construct require separation.

hypotheses.question: Commitment and reminders each inherit their package's efficacy.
hypotheses.reason: Joint condition does not establish independent component effect or synergy without exact contrast.

hypotheses.question: Observing pain consequences changes Observationally Learned Expectancy.
hypotheses.reason: Pain-intensity prediction following cues is not necessarily the canonical action-outcome probability; naturalistic clinical transfer not supported.

hypotheses.question: A placebo label implies a distinct observation identity and positive efficacy.
hypotheses.reason: Reviews used similar high/low cue manipulations under placebo/nocebo labels; identity is operation, not result label.

hypotheses.question: Changing reward probability raises the entire Reinforcement Expectancy profile.
hypotheses.reason: Probability and subjective value may diverge; existing multidimensional feature-scope gap applies.

hypotheses.question: Observational expectancy is narrower than Outcome Expectancy.
hypotheses.reason: Potential acquisition-route qualification, but exact scope must align expected consequence/probability and source attribution; no formal record from recall labels.

hypotheses.question: Reinforcement Expectancy duplicates Outcome Expectancy.
hypotheses.reason: Reward-contingent probability/value profile versus broader consequence expectation require scope comparison; no merge.

hypotheses.question: Reward sensitivity trait equals current reinforcement expectancy.
hypotheses.reason: Stable responsiveness to rewards and current probability/value belief are different.

hypotheses.question: Action+coping planning creates higher-order shopping habit.
hypotheses.reason: Package and higher-order definition differ from atomic repetition or if-then plan; six-month effect promising but exact matched habit measure needs extraction.

hypotheses.question: Culture shapes habitual cue dependence.
hypotheses.reason: No exact cultural-Driver contrast found in bounded search; country/context is not randomized culture or canonical entity.

hypotheses.question: Habit is a qualified state that transforms into automaticity.
hypotheses.reason: Different overlapping constructs do not literally transform into one another.

hypotheses.question: Goal strength moderates REL-PSY-036.
hypotheses.reason: Performance interaction in SRC114 is not an exact intention-strength→association effect; measured goal strength and primed goal activation differ.

hypotheses.question: Imitation performance directly measures action-outcome expectancy.
hypotheses.reason: Observed reproduction, incentive-sensitive performance and expected consequence likelihood differ; Bandura1965 screened only bibliographically.

canonicalSourceReviews.finding: Wood/Rünger2016 review DOI10.1146/annurev-psych-122414-033417; goal pursuit and habits can coexist. Model descriptions not empirical causal execution.
Verplanken/Orbell2003 scale combines repetition, automaticity and identity. Four validation studies do not identify composite→subscale causation.

Sheeran/Webb/Gollwitzer2005 DOI10.1177/0146167204271308:two studies goal strength/activation qualifies plan performance; measured strength not randomized moderator; no exact cue-link effect from outcome alone.

PMID resolves Webb/Sheeran2008 Mechanisms of implementation intention effects DOI10.1348/014466607X267010, not stored Webb/Sheeran/Luszczynska2007 Planning to break unwanted habits. Actual abstract:66tests negligible goal/self-efficacy change plus separate cue-link mediation study; no canonical correction or mislabeled independent replication.
Gollwitzer1999 implementation-intentions review, not an isolated current associative-strength trial.
Bandura1977 efficacy theory distinguishes efficacy from outcome expectations; not exact multidimensional reinforcement or observed-expectancy effect.
TDF validation not a habit/expectancy causal trial.
